messages:
rohit: Heads-up — staging started returning intermittent 502s for the embeddings route after the quant rebase. Looks like a serializer header mismatch in the rebuilt runtime. Need a fast hotfix and image pin. Proposing image `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-quickfix:2024-08-10-rc1`.

deploybot: Deploy request created (id=dr-8080). Required approvals: oncall + infra. Canary suggested: 3m. Flags: expedited=true, partial-rollout=true.

carmen: Oncall here, I can watch it. How big is the prod footprint? Any batching services that could amplify errors?

rohit: Prod traffic hitting this path is ~0.6% of requests but it's in a batch fan-in; retries could amplify. Staging saw ~4% of short-sequence embeds fail. Rollback criteria: embeddings.error_rate increase > 1.5% sustained 4m OR p95 latency > 800ms.

rohit: Rollback steps (copy/paste):
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-08-01
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# emergency undo
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=223
```

felix: Infra +1 for an expedited 10m midwindow at 21:30 UTC. I'll open the window once release notes and configmap hash are in place. @release-bot can you attach the canary snapshots?

release-bot: Release doc created (draft): https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2024-08-10-embed-quickfix. Please attach grafana snapshots and a short CV line. Auto-validate pending.

rohit: Canary in staging ran for 14m clean after the fix. I've uploaded grafana images and a short changelog: "embed: serializer header fix after quant rebase; pin quickfix image; rollback policy included." Configmap hash: `cfg-5e2a1d`.

felix: Good — infra +1 recorded. deploybot, please schedule expedited deploy with a 3m canary and 10m midwindow. Notify #incidents and #eng-releases.

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-8080 -> prod. Canary: 3m, then progressive rollout. Midwindow reserved 10m starting 1805556700. Monitors: /metrics/embeds/error_rate, embeddings.p95_latency, kv-cache.miss. Watchers: carmen, felix, rohit. Logs tail helper: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 100`

ops-bot: Alert ramp set: 30s. Bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-serializer-quickfix. Pager rules: if embeddings.error_rate > 1.5% for 4m -> page ops-lead + open incident. Notify channels: #incidents, #eng-releases.

carmen: Oncall ACK. I'll be watching p95 and error_rate and will trigger rollback (kubectl undo) and page #incidents if thresholds breach.

rohit: Thanks team — will post a short blameless follow-up after stabilization and attach final canary graphs. :white_check_mark:
